parsed.explanation: No trans-specific offence, facility ban, border/document practice or current organised targeting is documented, and adult same-sex conduct is not criminalised, so the unequal age of consent (21+, 5-10 years) is only a secondary, tangential exposure. Against that, the documented social record is hostile, not accepting: in 2024 many conceal identity to keep jobs and live safely, public expression is constrained and a 2021 LGBTQ party was cancelled, and in January 2025 the state rejected recommendations to combat anti-LGBT violence and hate speech. The only trans-specific violence finding is dated 2011, post-coup, recording verbal abuse, stone-throwing and murder, especially of trans sex workers, with no later instance documented - a dated signal of violent rejection, not a current frequency. No working visitor-facing remedy is documented. This is tier-3 societal hostility with thin recourse, in a thin-data setting extrapolated from state rejection of protection.
